description: Generate perfect mazes with DFS, navigate them with arrows/WASD or the on-screen pad, and reveal the solution path.

faqs.a: Recursive-backtracker (depth-first search) carves a perfect maze — exactly one path between any two cells.
Arrow keys, WASD, or the on-screen direction pad for touch devices.
Small (11×11), Medium (21×21), and Large (31×31) — a new maze generates when you change size.
Press Show Solution to overlay the shortest path from start to finish in gold.

howto: Pick a maze size — a fresh maze generates.
Move the red dot with arrows/WASD or the pad.
Reach the green goal square to win.
Press Show Solution to see the shortest path.
title: Maze Generator & Game
